1.consolidated_definition: Comportarse de modo inapropiado, con histeria y exhibicionismo. Anglicismo híbrido, usual. Pero si cree que va a montar un show de la calle aquí conmigo, señor, se equivocó (Tribunal Supremo, 19-10-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To behave in an inappropriate manner, with hysteria and exhibitionism. Hybrid Anglicism, commonly used. However, if you think you're going to put on a street show here with me, sir, you are mistaken (Supreme Court, 19-10-05)
